body:
My family has been cooking and eating dandelions for generations. Avoid the stem, it has latex in it and can be toxic for kids. As long as I can remember Ive used the greens in salad greens, dips, soups, and alfreido sauces.  The flowers and root can be used in wines, teas, or eaten raw. They taste about like they smell, but the leaves remind me of spinach.
So today I decided to try smoking it just for kicks. It seems to make me feel happy, and have a sort of mental clarity, although it doesnt make me feel more awake like coffee or something would. I tried smoking it with a little chamomile next and OH MY GOD thats where I am right now. Together they give me a mild, but very satisfying buzz, like taking a couple hits of weed. It tastes a lot like a good quality weed too, it doesnt have that skunk flavor. and Hey, its legal. I think Ill smoke this instead from now on, except on special occasions.
